selection: H39 repairs rejected-read delivery classification and repeats the unchanged H37 eight-path one-handle treatment. Round 23 samples are excluded. All benchmark gates remain fixed.
treatment: After the exact shared prefix, state branches receive cumulative evidence diversified across at most eight newest paths and one newest distinct receipt-bound handle per path in chronological order. Control receives no task state. Terminal envelope and credential changes are identical in both arms.

branch_order.method: predeclared alternating schedule over task index plus repetition; no outcome input

stopping_rules: Any prefix that terminates before its first recycle is retained as instrument-ineligible and is not replaced.
Any snapshot, ancestry, common-policy, receipt or pre-treatment identity mismatch stops that task before branch dispatch.
No within-round task, source, prompt, cap, threshold, state content, repetition count, order, replacement, or lucky rerun.
Record every prefix and branch model input/output token; unknown usage makes the pair ineligible.
claim_ceiling: Exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K causal development study; no reserved confirmation, larger-window, repair-correctness, transfer, or ContextBench clearance claim.
